formatBand.title: A new competition format, in Warsaw for the first time.
formatBand.body: To mark the debut of ACE BATTLE MILE, entry is free for teams and solo participants, and prizes await the winners.

whatIs.title: What is ACE BATTLE RUN RATING?

roles.title: Personal & team scoring
roles.body: Used to determine a runner’s individual and team level in the ACE BATTLE RUN rating system, and to qualify for a team-running division.

team.title: ACE BATTLE MILE GAME DIVISION’S
team.body: These are thrilling one-mile (1609 m) battles between teams, where both your personal result and your team’s result matter for the win.

rating.title: ACE BATTLE MILE LEAGUE’S
rating.body: This is where your path — and your team’s path — to the National and international league begins.

ratingPath.title: THE RATING IS YOUR PATH TO THE PRIZE FUND
ratingPath.lead: Earn rating points throughout the season and lead your team into the top ranks.
ratingPath.bannerHeading: In autumn, the best teams in their division will compete in the first National Ace Battle Mile Game League!
ratingPath.bannerSub: At stake — the title of the strongest running team, cash prizes and the right to represent your club and your city in the ACE BATTLE MILE Champions Leagues
ratingPath.kicker: WATCH THE NATIONAL LEAGUE PRIZE FUNDS

faq.title: Got questions?
faq.sub: our manager will reach out and answer everything

noTeam.q: Can I come without a team?
noTeam.a: Yes. If you don't have a team, just register solo. After the run we'll help form teams among participants based on their results.

cost.q: How much does it cost to take part?
cost.a: As ACE BATTLE is entering the Polish market for the first time, the first Warsaw qualifier is open to all participants free of charge.

deadline.a: Online registration is open until all spots are filled. On-site registration is available from 09:00 — but only while spots remain, with 300 available in total. We recommend registering in advance!

kids.a: Yes, kids are welcome as spectators alongside adults. Participation in the run depends on the format's age rules.

prep.a: No. The format is designed for any level — from beginners to seasoned runners. What matters is team spirit and the will to play.

bring.a: Comfortable sportswear and shoes, a good mood, and a bit of water. You'll get your bib and timing chip on site.

spectator.q: Can I come as a spectator?
spectator.a: Of course! We have stands for fans, an on-site café, and a full show throughout the day.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions govern your registration for and participation in TEAMS MILE Warsaw, organised by ACE BATTLE POLAND and held on 27 June 2026 at Stadion Podskarbińska, Warsaw. By registering, contacting us, or taking part in the event you accept these terms. Please read them together with the official Tournament Regulations.

p: TEAMS MILE Warsaw is a team mile race run under the ACE BATTLE rating system. The organiser is ACE BATTLE POLAND Ltd, a licensed event of the ACE BATTLE Association.

The full sporting rules — roles, divisions, time corrections, ranks and penalties — are set out in the Tournament Regulations and the ACE BATTLE Rating System Regulations, which form part of these terms.
You can register as a team captain (starting a team of 7–12 runners), as a runner joining an existing team with the captain's invite code, or as a free agent to be matched with a team later.

You confirm that the information you provide is accurate and that you are entitled to register the runners you add. Registration is confirmed once your entry is recorded and, where an entry fee applies, payment is completed.
The first 300 registered runners pay no entry fee. After the free allocation is used, the entry fee is 50 PLN per runner.

Payments are processed securely by our payment provider, Stripe. We never receive or store your full card number; Stripe handles card data under its own terms and security standards. We keep a record of your payment status and the payment-session reference so we can confirm your entry.
We only collect what we need to register you, run the event, and stay in touch. Depending on how you sign up, this includes:

items.d: identifies you on the start list, your bib and the results.
sends your confirmation and a secure single-use link to access your registration or team page.

p: We use your data to process your registration, manage teams and rosters, take payment where due, send event communications and your access links, check you in on race day, publish start lists and results, and respond to your enquiries.
We do not sell your personal data.

We share data only with the service providers who help us run the event: Stripe (payment processing) and our email provider (delivery of confirmations and access links). They process data on our behalf under their own security and privacy commitments.

We send transactional messages — registration confirmation, secure single-use links to access your team or runner page, and important event updates. If you contact us, we reply using the method you chose.
You may ask us to access, correct or delete your personal data, and you may withdraw consent for non-essential processing. To exercise these rights, use the contact details below.

You take part at your own responsibility and confirm that you are in adequate health to run. Please follow the organiser's and officials' instructions and the safety rules in the Tournament Regulations.
Photography and filming take place at the event and images may be used to promote ACE BATTLE events. Let the organiser know on site if you do not wish to be featured.
If the event is cancelled by the organiser, paid entry fees are handled according to our refund policy. Requests relating to payments should be sent to the contact below.
We may update these terms to reflect changes to the event or legal requirements. The current version always appears on this page with its last-updated date.
Questions about these terms or your data? Contact ACE BATTLE POLAND at info@aba.run or +48 576 696 078.
